body.title: Bound, display half of ac3, amendments and hand check
body.summary: Pin ac5 with tests over the existing bound (enqueue refuses at QUEUE_RECORD_BOUND with FULL_NOTE and leaves every row; a resend frees its own old row first, so at the bound it replaces that row and is never refused, as S001 built it; submit at the bound returns ok:false reason full) without new production code. List the existing S001 tests that carry ac3's display half in the TESTS record (turn-lifecycle.test.ts follow tests and chat-panel.test.ts reload-follow tests). Score k1-k5 against the finished change in the BUILD summary. List the three HLD amendments the question resolutions chose (sc1 methodAdd markNotDeliveredIfHead; sc2 methodAdd presenceOf plus the takeOver holderGone and own-key rule; the HLD 'flush' wording) as to be filed for the owner's approval, and say in the BUILD summary whether they were filed; they are not code and do not block the code tasks. Run the hand check in two windows: reload mid-turn with the CLI alive, reload with queued messages while a second window ticks, and close a window with queued messages.
acceptanceChecks: enqueue at the bound is refused with FULL_NOTE, a resend at the bound replaces its own old row and is not refused, and no row is lost
submit at the bound returns ok:false reason full
the TESTS record names the S001 follow tests for ac3's display half
the BUILD summary scores k1-k5 and states whether the three HLD amendments were filed
the hand check is recorded as a reported live test with its evidence
